stem: In the early 1600s, the astronomer Galileo used a telescope to make observations of Mercury and Venus. What are the positions of these planets in relation to the sun?

options.label: F
options.text: Mercury is the planet closest to the sun, and Venus is the second planet from the sun.

options.label: G
options.text: Mercury is the second planet from the sun, and Venus is the third planet from the sun.

options.label: H
options.text: Venus is the planet closest to the sun, and Mercury is the second planet from the sun.

options.label: J
options.text: Mercury is the third planet from the sun, and Venus is the planet closest to the sun.
